summary.narrative: The agent ran free cooling for 5 of 23 hours with 1 mode change. The reactive incumbent took 23 hours -- 18 more -- but declared 0 unsafe hours against the agent's 0. 7 hours were safe but still ran chillers, because the schedule could not afford them.

hours.why: Mechanical, and the reason is a REFUSAL rather than a temperature. At this wind bearing a building sits between the condensers and the air intake. The dispersion model has no representation of a building standing in the flow, so any number it produced here would be meaningless. The agent declines to certify the hour instead of returning a figure it cannot stand behind.

Mechanical EVEN THOUGH THIS HOUR IS SAFE. Every gate passes -- the bound is 1.207 C against a 18.0 C limit. The schedule is what forbids it: no relaxation of either the switch budget or the dwell would free it, so the surrounding hours are worth more. This is the one explanation a thermostat cannot give, because a thermostat has no plan to be constrained by. It is also why the decision is a schedule and not a comparison: spending a mode change here would cost a better one later.
